message: The declared security scheme has no supported authentication profile. The scheme name is preserved so a reviewer can see what was required.
remediation: Bind an alternative supported scheme, or add an adapter for this scheme before approving a binding.

message: Only JSON request and response bodies are in the executable subset. This one operation cannot be bound; the rest of the document stays discoverable.
remediation: Use a JSON operation, or extend the executable subset deliberately with its own conformance result.

message: The API key this scheme needs is not present in this deployment. The adapter is implemented; it is not usable here until the value is supplied.
remediation: Supply the named configuration through the private collection path, then approve a binding.

message: A recursive schema is preserved by reference rather than expanded. Validation runs to an explicit depth instead of declaring recursion invalid.
The document uses a construct the requested older export version cannot carry. No document is produced rather than one that silently drops it.
remediation: Export at the document's own version, or remove the construct upstream.
